title: Correct release height
description: Essential: The response must correctly derive or state the release height as H = v²/(2g).

title: Correct tension force
description: Essential: The response must correctly derive or state the tension as F = mg + m(v²/L).

title: Correct energy loss
description: Essential: The response must correctly derive or state the mechanical energy loss as ΔE = (1/4)mv².

title: Energy conservation for height
description: Important: The solution should apply conservation of mechanical energy (or work-energy theorem) to relate the release height H to the speed v before collision.

title: Centripetal force for tension
description: Important: The solution should apply Newton's second law for circular motion to find the tension, recognizing the force balance at the bottom of the swing.

title: Momentum conservation for collision
description: Important: The solution should apply conservation of linear momentum to find the common velocity after the perfectly inelastic collision.

title: Energy loss calculation
description: Important: The solution should correctly calculate the energy loss from the difference in kinetic energy before and after the collision.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the tension force equation incorrectly subtracts the centripetal term (e.g., F = mg - mv²/L) or misapplies force directions.

title: Incorrect collision physics
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the solution assumes elastic collision, uses conservation of kinetic energy for the collision, or incorrectly calculates the post-collision velocity.
